title: azdo-emu.yaml
description: Configuration for azdo-emu, placed next to the pipeline file. All keys are optional; command-line flags override these values, which override the defaults shown as `default` below.

organization.description: Azure DevOps organization URL, used as context for @alias resolution, variable groups and the org schema.

auth.description: How to authenticate to each service.

parameters.description: Default values for the pipeline's runtime parameters. Overridden per key by --parameter; values are bound and type-checked against the pipeline's declared parameter types at convert time.

repositories.description: Repository alias overrides: point an alias at a local working copy instead of fetching it. Relative paths resolve from this file's directory.

path.description: Local path to use for this alias.

listNames.description: List variable-group *names* in .env.example when signed in. Values are never fetched.

min.description: Fail conversion (exit 3) when the coverage report is below this percentage. 0 = report only.

unknown.description: What to do with a task that has no handler.

execute.description: Tasks to run in high-fidelity real-task mode.

targetOs.description: Target OS for the generated scripts, overriding pool inference.

checkoutMode.description: How repositories are materialized into the workspace.

sharedWorkspace.description: Share one workspace across jobs instead of isolating each job.

execution.description: Where the generated project executes (sandbox isolation).

environment.description: auto = sandbox when docker/podman is present, otherwise host.

dockerSocket.description: Host docker-socket passthrough for pipelines that use docker.
